about_the_game:
Give your players a lovely farm to run when they’re not off adventuring with the Winlu Fantasy Exterior Add-on Farm Tiles pack! Winlu is back with another addition to their Fantasy Exterior series, this time focusing on healthy plants and rustic charm to turn any houses you’ve already built into a working farm. 1 B sheet includes wood and thatch angled roofs to build barns, and short stone walls to keep your wheat fields separate from your livestock. Chicken coops and feed troughs are perfect for keeping your animals fed and safe, and some scattered piles of hay can add to the feeling that this is a busy farm with a working windmill.

And once you’ve set up the map, add more life to your farm with this pack’s character sprites! Have white and brown cows wander a grassy field where they can be milked, and give pigs some treats in the hopes of them digging up some useful items. Chickens can offer eggs (just watch out for the aggressive rooster!), and swarms of bees can be carefully followed back to their hive to gather healing honey. If animals aren’t your hero’s focus, then fill the fields with wheat, corn, and sunflowers that all grow and await harvesting. Smaller plots can grow carrots, cabbages, turnips, grapes, pumpkins, and tomatoes that your heroes could sell for extra cash, and let your heroes smash the rocks that appear in the fields to possibly find gold or silver ore. Pick up the Winlu Fantasy Exterior Add-on Farm Tiles pack and add some money-making farms to your towns and villages!


This tilesheet contains:

-1 tilesheet
-16 Character spritesheets


Terms of Use:

This pack is for use in RPG Maker Series or the engine of your choice.
OK to be used in Commercial projects
Contents can be edited

OK for use in adult-rated games
